description: Northstar OS subscription plan catalog (beta build). Entitlements declare which live gates a plan WOULD cover for a subscriber. A plan never flips a gate: gates_always_off=true, and executing any live action additionally requires a fresh, named operator approval per action.

plans.name: Foundation
plans.blurb: Free beta tier — full Services Suite in demo / read surfaces. No live gates included.

plans.name: Scout
plans.blurb: Discovery + listing drafting with live read access to sourcing, enrichment, and ads analytics.

plans.name: Mover
plans.blurb: Everything in Scout, plus AI media generation and attribution workflows.

plans.name: AutothinK
plans.blurb: Premium build-anything layer on top of Mover — includes every service gate and the AutothinK workspace.
